speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues. To better understand what might be causing these symptoms, have you noticed any stiffness or slowness in your movements? Also, how would you describe the nature of your memory problems—specifically, are you forgetting recent conversations or events?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with early cognitive impairment (Parkinson's Disease Dementia).
